description: Completeness taxonomy and metric validity matrix for the AXIOM reference corpus. Canonical source for which structural metrics are valid per completeness level. Per-file provenance metadata lives in file-manifest.json.

completenessLevels.complete_piece: Self-contained short work (bagatelle, waltz, dance, character piece). All structural metrics valid: referenceDistanceScore, climaxPosition, phraseDistribution, formalArc, movementLevelIdentityProfile, beethovenianArchitecture, schubertianPhraseExpansion.
completenessLevels.complete_movement: Complete single movement of a multi-movement work. All structural metrics valid for that movement type, including movementLevelIdentityProfile, beethovenianArchitecture, schubertianPhraseExpansion.
completenessLevels.complete_section: Complete labeled section within a larger formal structure (e.g. variation theme, da capo section, introductory Grave). phraseDistribution, cadencePlacement, technique metrics valid; referenceDistanceScore, climaxPosition, formalArc, movementLevelIdentityProfile NOT valid.
completenessLevels.excerpt: Partial extract from a longer work (opening passage, thematic phrase, introduction). Local technique ONLY: motivicCell, localHarmonicColor, texturePattern, cadenceFormula, voiceLeadingPattern, pianoFiguration. No movement-level metrics.
completenessLevels.incipit_only: Opening bars only (≤8 measures). Opening gesture and motif ONLY: openingMotif, openingGesture, openingTexture. No structural or technique metrics.
